scope: Unchanged original Findutils permission and large-exec tests run as uid/gid 65534 in owned private trees. Executables are copied by verified byte identity so /root permissions do not interfere. Every applet invocation is instrumented in Valgrind profiles. The 7200-file exec-nogaps case uses trace-children=no and child-silent-after-fork=yes: its native helper executables are pinned but are not instrumented; other cases retain full child tracing.
